description: This file contains functions to generate initial seed data for a habit and task tracking application, including creating sample habits and tasks, and assembling the initial application state.

methods.name: makeHabit({ name, description, color, completedDaysAgo = [] })
methods.description: Creates a habit object with a unique ID, computed streaks, and completion dates based on input parameters.

methods.name: makeTask({ title, description, status, priority, dueDate, tags, completedAt })
methods.description: Creates a task object with a unique ID and specified attributes.

ctags.name: makeTask
ctags.pattern: /^function makeTask({ title, description, status, priority, dueDate, tags, completedAt }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ title, description, status, priority, dueDate, tags, completedAt })
